answer: In an agent economy trading lagoon surveys, prism designs, and orchard forecasts, each voting identity must lock 100 tokens for 90 days before its vote counts. Creating new keys is free, but each extra counted identity requires another bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 votes must therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens for three months, paying financing costs and risking token depreciation. This makes influence costly even when identities are cheap.
